summary: Check whether 58/256 belongs in this reference list
rationale: The giant-and-pit quotation matches the supplied best-match verse PrS 37/88 exactly in context. In contrast, 58/256 reads I naqqa d aṯi, d gəšle appe, hiye ste ʕaṣi, about touching people and becoming stuck; it has gəšle rather than dəšle. The reference may be a supplementary attestation or an error, and the supplied evidence does not identify a replacement.
